title: Sulforaphane promotes the removal of doxorubicin-induced senescent epithelial and breast cancer cells and activates AhR/CYP1A1-based adaptive response in vitro.
authors: Solarska-Sciuk, Katarzyna; Kapavarapu, Ravikumar; Poliszak, Zuzanna; Wnuk, Maciej; Lewinska, Anna
one_liner_zh: 该文研究莱菔硫烷对阿霉素诱导衰老乳腺癌细胞的作用及AhR/CYP1A1通路，仅含分子对接预测小分子-蛋白相互作用，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Sulforaphane (SFN), an isothiocyanate derived from cruciferous vegetables, is characterized by antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anticancer properties by activating NRF2 pathway, suppressing NFkappaB pathway, and promoting apoptotic cell death signals and epigenetic changes, respectively. However, SFN-based action against drug-induced senescent cells has never been addressed. In the present study, three breast cancer cell lines with different receptor status, namely triple negative BT-549 and HCC38, and MDA-MB-361 (ER-positive, HER2-positive) along with normal epithelial MCF-10F cells were subjected to 5 muM SFN treatment at both proliferating and non-proliferating (doxorubicin-induced senescence) state. BT-549 proliferating cells were more prone to SFN stimulation than normal ones that was accompanied by oxidative stress-based apoptosis. In contrast, SFN was active in a similar manner against both drug-induced senescent normal and breast cancer cells that resulted in apoptosis-mediated elimination of non-proliferating cells. SFN also stimulated adaptive responses in doxorubicin-induced senescent cells as judged by the activation of aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR)/cytochrome P450 1A1 (CYP1A1) pathway and upregulation of heat shock protein 90 (HSP90). In silico analysis with molecular docking also predicted SFN interactions with selected proteins involved in drug detoxification and cell death that warrants further investigation. We postulate that SFN may have senotherapeutic potential, especially against apoptosis resistant chemotherapy-induced senescent normal and breast cancer cells.
abstract_zh: 莱菔硫烷 (Sulforaphane, SFN) 是一种源自十字花科蔬菜的异硫氰酸酯，通过激活NRF2通路、抑制NFkappaB通路，并分别促进凋亡性细胞死亡信号和表观遗传改变，展现出抗氧化、抗炎和抗癌特性。然而，基于SFN对抗药物诱导衰老细胞的作用尚未被探讨。在本研究中，三种具有不同受体状态的乳腺癌细胞系，即三阴性BT-549和HCC38，以及MDA-MB-361（ER阳性、HER2阳性），连同正常上皮MCF-10F细胞，在增殖状态和非增殖状态（多柔比星诱导的衰老）下均接受5 μM SFN处理。BT-549增殖细胞对SFN刺激比正常细胞更敏感，并伴随基于氧化应激的凋亡。相反，SFN对药物诱导的衰老正常细胞和乳腺癌细胞以类似方式发挥作用，导致非增殖细胞通过凋亡介导被消除。SFN还刺激了多柔比星诱导衰老细胞中的适应性反应，这通过芳烃受体 (aryl hydrocarbon receptor, AhR)/细胞色素P450 1A1 (cytochrome P450 1A1, CYP1A1) 通路的激活和热休克蛋白90 (heat shock protein 90, HSP90) 的上调得以判断。分子对接的计算机模拟分析也预测了SFN与参与药物解毒和细胞死亡的选定蛋白质的相互作用，这值得进一步研究。我们推测SFN可能具有衰老治疗潜力，特别是针对抗凋亡的化疗诱导衰老正常细胞和乳腺癌细胞。
